## Common **questions**

### 01How do I get started with RevenueBase?

There are two paths. Self-service: sign up at revenuebase.ai to get 500 free API credits and free masked data feeds — no sales call or credit card required. Assisted: book a demo through the RevenueBase website for a guided walkthrough of the platform, data coverage discussion, and pricing conversation. Most developer integrations can be started within a day of account creation.

### 02How long does RevenueBase onboarding take?

For API and data feed customers, onboarding typically takes a few hours to a few days depending on the integration complexity and the customer's internal data infrastructure. RevenueBase provides architectural onboarding support, data dictionaries, and documentation to speed the process. Gigasheet (no-code browser access) can be accessed immediately after account setup.

### 03What support does RevenueBase provide?

RevenueBase provides onboarding support, ongoing technical support via shared Slack channels and a ticketing system, and access to documentation and data dictionaries. Enterprise customers receive dedicated support and architectural guidance. Support terms vary by plan — contact RevenueBase for details on support SLAs.

### 04Can I get sample data before committing to a purchase?

Yes. RevenueBase offers 500 free API credits and free masked data feeds (full schema with PII redacted) for evaluation. Customers can also request sample data files for specific use cases. Contact the RevenueBase team to discuss a pilot program or custom evaluation for larger enterprise deployments.

### 05Can RevenueBase enrich a sample list for evaluation purposes?

Yes. RevenueBase can enrich a sample list as part of the evaluation process to demonstrate data coverage and quality against your specific target market. Contact the RevenueBase team to arrange a sample enrichment.

### 06How do I contact RevenueBase for support?

RevenueBase support can be reached through the contact form at revenuebase.ai, via shared Slack channels (available to customers), or through the ticketing system. For new inquiries, the fastest path is the contact form or the "Get a Demo" booking page.
